name: @neuropause/reliability
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 4: Enterprise Production Validation, Reliability & Security Hardening. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprints 1-3, unchanged, into an evidence-first production-validation and reliability layer: a production validation runtime; end-to-end validation that runs REAL cross-subsystem execution traces (identity/authn/authz, AI, integration, business, operations); performance engineering, load/stress/endurance testing (REUSING the operations PerformanceMonitor's real in-process harness + real memory/CPU sampling); controlled in-process chaos engineering (never touching production systems); recovery validation (REUSING production backups/DR); security hardening (dependency/container/static/secret/config/image/supply-chain/runtime); a penetration-testing framework (represents tests; never claims certification); compliance readiness for ISO 27001/SOC 2/HIPAA/GDPR/PCI DSS (generates evidence packages; never claims compliance); reliability engineering (availability, error budgets, MTTR/MTBF, incident timelines, reliability scoring); an SLO/SLA platform; operational readiness; a release-candidate platform (never declares GA); production diagnostics; observability validation; governance; documentation. Validation runtime, reliability runtime, performance engine, recovery validation, security validation, diagnostics, documentation, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED; external scanners/compliance tools/cloud-monitoring/third-party-security platforms are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; production customer workloads/real incident history/operational trends/customer baselines are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; customer production clusters/production-scale traffic/multi-region failover/external DR sites are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. Measurements are never fabricated; compliance is never claimed; no GA is declared. Every reliability operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
